# Changelog — shadcn-theme-default

All notable changes to this skill will be documented in this file.

## [1.0.0] — 2025-02-19

### Added
- Initial release
- Default Neutral theme with OKLCH CSS variables
- Light and dark mode complete variable sets
- Tailwind v4 integration with @theme inline directive
- Tailwind v3 legacy support with HSL variables
- Dark mode setup with next-themes
- Component styling patterns (buttons, cards, inputs, badges)
- Full globals.css template
- Tailwind version auto-detection guidance
